CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $120,000 - $175,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

Benefits Summary

The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site: https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/ .

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.

As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.

* * *

**About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our [Total Rewards philosophy](https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards).

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**

Gusto's Customer Experience team is changing how we serve small businesses: new service models, a telephony platform migration, and the data infrastructure to support both. We are hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to own the data layer that makes this work.

You will work directly with CX leaders to identify and scope priorities, own the foundation of pipelines, data models, and dashboards that make CX data trustworthy, and use that foundation to answer causal questions about what actually moves customer outcomes. The strongest candidates pair real coding and statistical depth with the judgment to know which question is worth answering.

**About the Team:**

CX Data and Insights is the analytical backbone of Gusto's Customer Experience organization. We define the metrics CX leaders run the business on, and we produce the analysis that shapes operational roadmap decisions.

**Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:**

* **Lead:** Own ambiguous problems, design analysis and measurement frameworks, and introduce policies and practices by which data integrity is monitored and enforced within your domain.
* **Execution:** Deliver multiple high-impact projects, balancing trade-offs to maximize business value, and maintain clear expectations of deliverables and timelines.
* **Strategic Partnership:** Partner with CX leaders, cross-function data-science teams, tool developers (i.e. Salesforce), and data engineering to align on strategy.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Apply advanced statistical methods and AI-driven anomaly detection to proactively uncover opportunities, diagnose performance issues, and shape CX strategy, separating signal from noise. Navigate messy, conflicting data sources to establish reliable sources of truth. Use AI to accelerate hypothesis generation, code drafting, cross-source reconciliation, validation, and build agents to automate repetitive tasks.
* **Develop and scale reporting:** Define DBT and Snowflake data pipeline requirements for evolving CX data sources, build and maintain monitoring systems, and streamline dashboards for day-to-day operation and self-serve insights.
* **Independence:** Independently determines analytical research, metrics and/or data products to achieve annual objectives, and proactively resolving conflicts or misalignment across stakeholders.
* **Scale the Craft:** Up-level the team’s best practices in data modeling and schema design, expand our toolsets (e.g., Databricks for AI-augmented modeling and anomaly detection) where they accelerate CX outcomes, drive improvements in data quality, rigor, and adoption of better data capabilities, and mentor other data practitioners.
* **Communication:** Present complex findings in a structured, compelling way to technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a data-informed mindset across the company.

**Here’s what we're looking for:**

* 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Governance.
* Strong SQL and Python proficiency, capable of querying and analyzing large datasets with ease.
* Strong foundation in data modeling, schema design, and data quality best practices, with functional experience working on cloud platforms like Snowflake.
* Proven experience building and maintaining robust data reporting pipelines and ETL workflows.
* Demonstrated experience designing or operating governance for AI-assisted analytics outputs. At minimum: validation standards for AI-generated code and metric definitions, drift and source-of-truth audits on dashboards that feed operational decisions, and documented rules for when human review is non-negotiable on performance-adjacent data products. Comfort working inside an organization's AI use policy.
* Clear, direct communication style. You can explain a complex data investigation to a non-technical stakeholder in 1-2 sentences before diving into the details.
* Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward without waiting for perfect requirements.
* Frequent, practical use of AI in analytics workflows with concrete examples (not aspirational interest). You can describe specific ways AI has changed how you scaffold pipelines, write and review code, validate data, or generate documentation, and you know where human verification is non-negotiable.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $132,210/yr to $165,263/yr in Denver, $160,000/yr to $200,000/yr for New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

* * *

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

* * *

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

**Reliable, consistent presence:** We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

* * *

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out [this form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdEfl7Bp-Twz7LLlhGlha46CrxZ9Kacgakmarf3K2TbnaEgKQ/viewform) and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our [Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer](https://gusto.com/about/careers/fraudulent-activity-disclaimer).

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to [Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice](https://gusto.com/about/careers/applicant-privacy-notice).

About New York Life Investment Management

With over $800 billion in assets under management, NYLIM is a Pensions & Investments ' Top 30 Largest Money Manager and one of the largest global asset managers serving institutional, retail and insurance clients. NYLIM brings together the firm’s global investment teams under one unified brand, combining specialized expertise with the strength and stability of New York Life.

Our platform is built on disciplined active management, deep investment capabilities and a long-term partnership approach designed to deliver enduring value across market cycles and help clients navigate the next era of investing.

More powerful, together, we combine the agility of specialized investment teams with the scale and longevity of a leading mutual institution.
Senior Associate – Business Intelligence Analyst

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified and motivated candidate to join the Institutional Intelligence team within New York Life Investment Management’s Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Group . This role will support our Private Fixed Income team within New York Life Investment Management and play a pivotal part in enhancing the tools, reporting, and workflows that support the evaluation and monitoring of a portfolio of privately placed, investment-grade securities, including corporate, infrastructure, and private ABS transactions.

This position offers a dynamic opportunity to expand a business and technology professional's expertise within the investment management industry, working in a results-oriented environment while cultivating meaningful relationships across investment, operations, and technology teams.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Associate supporting our Private Fixed Income investment teams, your primary focus will be to lead our partnership with investment professionals and technology stakeholders to enhance the platforms, reporting capabilities, and business processes supporting investment activities. Your key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Investment Process Support & Business Analysis

• Partner with investment professionals to support origination, underwriting, and portfolio management workflows across private investment-grade transactions.

• Gather business requirements and translate investment team needs into scalable reporting, dashboards, and technology solutions.

• Assist in developing tools, templates, and analyses that support underwriting, credit monitoring, portfolio surveillance, and investment committee materials.

Platform Management & Reporting

• Own and maintain the deal/portfolio management platforms used to track investments pipeline and portfolio activity across PFI and ABF.

• Build dashboards, reports, and workflows that support credit monitoring, deal tracking, and investment committee materials, reducing manual data gathering for portfolio managers and analysts.

• Support the rollout and adoption of AI-enabled tools for credit memo drafting, covenant monitoring, and portfolio reporting.

• Act as the primary liaison between the Investments team and Operations/IT on platform enhancements, data integration, and systems issues affecting investment workflows.

This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by empowering our investment professionals with the technology platforms, reporting capabilities, and streamlined processes needed to enhance investment decision-making and operational effectiveness.

Required Skills

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in a business analyst, technology, platform management, or business process improvement role within the financial services or investment management industry.

• Strong business analysis and problem-solving skills , with demonstrated experience gathering requirements, evaluating business processes, and translating stakeholder needs into effective solutions.

• Hands-on experience supporting business-critical systems and analytical platforms , preferably within an investment management environment.

• Working knowledge of SQL, Python and Excel , with the ability to analyze datasets, support reporting requirements, and collaborate with technical teams on data-related initiatives.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills , with the ability to interact effectively with investment professionals, Operations, IT, and stakeholders across various levels of the organization.

• Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency , accountability, and personal responsibility, capable of independently identifying challenges and driving solutions.

Preferred Skills

• Experience working with investment management platforms (RiskSpan, dv01) supporting private fixed income, private credit, asset-backed finance, or portfolio management.

• Experience developing or maintaining dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools.

• Experience working with Snowflake

• Python skills for reporting automation, data manipulation, and workflow optimization.

• Experience supporting API integrations, data migrations, and system implementation initiatives.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their application to investment workflows, credit monitoring, and reporting automation.

Job Level:

Pay Transparency

Salary Range:

Overtime eligible:

Discretionary bonus eligible:

Sales bonus eligible:

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work. Click here to discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site .

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.

Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation . We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careers page of www.NewYorkLife.com .

Job Requisition ID: 94770

**Who:** HealtheConnections, a respected national leader in providing health information exchange (HIE) services for NYS-based organizations.

**What:** We’re looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to turn customer and business data into meaningful insights that support decision-making, improve operations, and strengthen customer engagement.

You’ll partner with internal teams to develop reports, dashboards, analytics, CRM solutions, and business application improvements. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with complex data, understanding business needs, and turning them into practical, user-friendly solutions.

**Why:** Data is central to how we serve our customers and operate effectively. This role will work with a variety of data, including customer, ticketing, system usage, and market data**.**

**What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing**

* 35% Reporting & Analytics: Build reports and dashboards, analyze data, identify trends, and provide insights.
* 15%  CRM & Business Applications: Configure and improve Salesforce/CRM reporting, dashboards, workflows, and related solutions.
* 10% Business Partnership: Work with internal teams to understand needs and translate them into practical data and reporting solutions.
* 10% Data Quality: Identify and resolve data and reporting issues to ensure information is accurate and reliable.
* 10% Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reporting, automation, processes, and user experience.
* 10% Data Management & Excel: Work with complex datasets and use Excel and other tools to organize and present information.
* 10%  Documentation, Research & Support: Document solutions, evaluate new capabilities, and support ongoing improvements.

**Competencies & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.
* Experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, CRM administration, business applications, or a related field.
* Experience with the primary responsibilities listed above.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with complex data sets.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects and solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* SQL and Tableau experience strongly preferred.
* Salesforce experience strongly preferred.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Research shows that women and members of other underrepresented groups tend not to apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

*It is important to HealtheConnections that the hiring process is driven by humans. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools do not determine which candidates HealtheConnections chooses to interview or hire.*

***You’re a great fit for us if you’re good at…***

* **Turning data into insights.** You enjoy taking complex or disconnected information and finding the story or opportunity within it.
* **Solving problems.** You approach challenges analytically and look for practical solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
* **Understanding people and processes.** You can listen to what someone needs, understand the underlying business problem, and translate it into a useful solution.
* **Communicating clearly**. You can explain data, reporting, technical concepts, and recommendations in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Paying attention to the details**. You understand that reliable reporting starts with accurate, well-managed data.

***We’re a great fit for you if you’re looking for…***

* **A high-performance, high-energy, collaborative environment.** One of the best things about working here is our team. They’re smart, supportive, passionate, and among the best in the business.
* **A dynamic industry.** Health information exchange has exciting opportunities on the horizon as the healthcare industry evolves, both within NYS and on the national stage.
* **Strong benefits.** We cover the cost of medical insurance for employees along with a full suite of benefits, including 401k matching, generous vacation/holiday time, unlimited sick time, flexibility in work hours and hybrid/remote work, and more.
* **Work that makes a difference in your community.** We’re proud to make an impact on the daily lives of health professionals and support improved health outcomes for individuals right here in New York State.

We like to say that we’re “casually competent” – we’re not pretentious, but we know our stuff. Our people are talented, our culture is vibrant, and our work is at the top of its class. Even better, our customers genuinely like working with us, and we’ve seen firsthand how what we do has made a positive impact on our community.

$70,000-$90,000 is the lowest to highest salary that we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, the prevailing minimum wage for the location, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and seniority.

WSA – Wonderful Sound for All is a global leader in the hearing aid industry. Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. Our portfolio of technologies spans the full spectrum of hearing care, from distinct hearing brands and digital platforms to managed care, hearing centers and diagnostics locations.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Senior Business Intelligence Analyst / BI Developer who loves navigating data and turning it into dashboards that people actually use. Reporting to the Director, Sales Operations, you will own the build-out and quality of our Power BI and Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) reporting for the WSA USA business.

You are the kind of Senior Analyst who doesn't wait to be asked. You dig into the data, spot what's off or missing, and come back with a fix and a better way of doing it. You are comfortable moving between Salesforce, our ERP and data warehouse, and Excel, and you use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter. If you want to be the go-to person for "what does the data say?" in a growing commercial organization, this role is for you.

Position Details:

• Job Type: Permanent, full-time

• Department: Finance

• Location: Iselin, New Jersey or Hauppauge, New York Office

• Working Model: Hybrid

• Base range - $100,000 - $135,000.00

• Total Rewards Package: comprehensive benefits package, 401k matching program, tuition reimbursement & continuous learning programs, employee and family discount programs, generous PTO programs

What you'll be responsible for:
Dashboards & Insights

• Design, build, and maintain Power BI and CRMA dashboards that give sales, finance, and leadership a clear, trusted view of performance.

• Translate business questions into intuitive, well-designed reports, focusing on the few metrics that matter rather than more data.

• Analyze trends, variances, and anomalies and proactively bring forward insights and recommendations, not just numbers.

Data Management & Quality

• Extract, transform, and model data from Salesforce, ERP, data warehouse, and other sources (Power Query, SQL, CRMA recipes/dataflows).

• Own data accuracy and integrity across our reporting suite; find, troubleshoot, and resolve discrepancies before stakeholders do.

• Integrate new data sources as business needs evolve.

Reporting Governance & Documentation

• Establish and maintain consistent KPI definitions, reporting standards, and documentation of data sources, logic, and models.

• Keep reporting solutions reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain.

Stakeholder Partnership

• Partner with sales, finance, and commercial leaders to understand their needs, challenge requirements where useful, and deliver practical solutions.

• Work with IT and global BI teams to improve our data foundation and reporting processes.

AI & Automation

• Use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, AI features in Power BI and CRMA, generative AI assistants) to speed up analysis, automate recurring reporting, and generate narrative insights.

• Identify and drive opportunities to automate manual work, including building agents, bots, or workflows as the role grows.

• Stay current on BI and AI capabilities and bring forward ideas we haven't thought of yet.

What success looks like in your first year:

• Our core Power BI and CRMA dashboards are trusted, used weekly by leadership, and owned by you.

• Recurring manual reports are automated or meaningfully streamlined.

• You've identified and fixed data quality issues at the source, not just in the report.

• Stakeholders come to you first with their data questions.

What we're looking for:
Must-have

• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Economics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence.

• Proven, hands-on experience building Power BI dashboards (data modeling, DAX, Power Query).

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA / Tableau CRM), including dashboards and recipes/dataflows, and comfort working with Salesforce data.

• Strong SQL and advanced Excel skills.

• Active, everyday use of AI tools in your work, with curiosity about how to apply them further.

• A proactive, ownership-driven mindset: you spot problems and opportunities and act on them without being asked.

• Strong attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy.

• Ability to communicate data clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-have

• Experience in a B2B, sales, distribution, or commercial environment.

• Experience with Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Python, or similar automation tools.

• Exposure to forecasting or predictive analytics.

When applying, you will be asked to include a short example of a dashboard you've built or a data problem you identified and solved on your own initiative.
